recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the FHIR-29593 intent in the current active source without taking on broader THO canonical cleanup or Extension Pack follow-up from related issues.
issue_request: FHIR-29593 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary issue requesting that the Conformance Expectation CodeSystem include a SHALL-NOT code/display and a definition stating that support for the specified capability is prohibited to be considered conformant.
initial_application: The issue was first applied in git commit ffdf5bcf1e0e, which added SHALL-NOT to the temporary source/capabilitystatement2/codesystem-conformance-expectation.xml. That temporary CapabilityStatement2 source was later removed by 6e3572528e77. The active source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-conformance-expectation.xml later received SHALL-NOT in f094b0ede945 for FHIR-40228, but with malformed definition wording.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement remains active in source/fhir.ini and the active conformance-expectation ValueSet composes all codes from http://hl7.org/fhir/conformance-expectation, so the current source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-conformance-expectation.xml is in build scope. FHIR-40228 and FHIR-44609 show later FHIR-I handling that keeps SHALL-NOT in the broader ConformanceExpectation code system while CapabilityStatement-specific prohibition is represented through capabilitystatement-prohibited rather than the capabilitystatement-expectation extension.
reconciliation: Changed only the SHALL-NOT definition from the malformed 'should not occur only in any circumstance' wording to 'should not occur in any circumstance.' The existing SHALL-NOT code and display were retained.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-conformance-expectation.xml: corrected the SHALL-NOT concept definition by removing the erroneous word 'only' from the prohibition sentence.

related_jiras.note: Later applied FHIR-core issue re-added SHALL-NOT to the active CapabilityStatement CodeSystem source after CapabilityStatement2 was removed, but introduced the malformed definition wording corrected here.
FHIR-extensions issue confirms the distinction between capabilitystatement-expectation and capabilitystatement-prohibited for SHALL-NOT/prohibition usage in CapabilityStatements.
